meta.description: Synthetic labelled Instagram captions for Thrift-It. Labels list the policy clauses each post violates, written from the policy documents by the AI assistant that authored the posts. They have NOT been reviewed by a human (labelsReviewed=false on every post).
meta.splits: dev = calibration/tuning allowed; test = held out, never used to tune prompts, thresholds or weights.
meta.matching: A predicted finding matches an expected violation when it cites the same clause ID.
